name: Laundry Branch Financial Reports Automation - Auto Login POS Hostinger

parameters.content:
## Daily Financial Report
Auto Login POS version for Hostinger n8n. No cookie copy, no environment variables.

parameters.jsCode: const p=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Dubai',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(new Date()); const g=(t)=>p.find(x=>x.type===t)?.value; const d=`${g('year')}-${g('month')}-${g('day')}`; return [{json:{from_date:d,to_date:d,period_label:d}}];

parameters.jsCode:
const vars=(typeof $vars==='object'&&$vars)?$vars:{}; const s=$json.summary||{}; const r=$('Daily Date Range').first().json; const m=(v)=>Number(v||0).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); const net=Number(s.cash_receipt||0)-Number(s.cash_expense_total||0); const base=String(vars.REPORT_APP_BASE_URL||'').replace(//+$/,''); const branchId=String(vars.REPORT_BRANCH_ID||'').trim(); const query=new URLSearchParams({from_date:r.from_date,to_date:r.to_date,period_label:r.period_label||r.from_date}); if(branchId) query.set('branch_id',branchId); const generatedLink=String($json.operations_report?.share_url||$json.operations_report_link||''); const reportLink=generatedLink||(base?`${base}/performance-report?${query.toString()}`:''); const linkLine=reportLink?`

📎 التقرير التفاعلي الاحترافي:
${reportLink}`:''; const msg=`📊 التقرير المالي اليومي
📅 التاريخ: ${s.date_range||r.period_label}

🏪 الفرع: ${s.branch||'غير محدد'}
💰 إجمالي المبيعات: ${m(s.total_income)} AED
💵 الكاش: ${m(s.cash_receipt)} AED

📉 مصروفات الكاش: ${m(s.cash_expense_total)} AED
💳 مصروفات البطاقة: ${m(s.credit_card_expense_total)} AED
📉 إجمالي المصروفات: ${m(s.expense_total)} AED
✅ صافي الكاش الموجود: ${m(net)} AED
🧾 عدد الطلبات: ${Number(s.total_invoice||0)}${linkLine}`; const ownerMsg=`📊 تقرير يومي لكل الأفرع
📅 ${r.period_label||r.from_date}

📎 التقرير جاهز للفتح مباشرة:
${reportLink||'REPORT_LINK_NOT_READY'}`; return [{json:{whatsapp_to:'REPLACE_MANAGEMENT_GROUP_ID_OR_PHONE',message:msg,summary:s,report_link:reportLink,operations_report:$json.operations_report,owner_message:ownerMsg,owner_whatsapp:String(vars.REPORT_OWNER_WHATSAPP||'REPLACE_OWNER_WHATSAPP'),owner_telegram_chat_id:String(vars.REPORT_OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID||'REPLACE_OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID')}}];

parameters.content:
## Weekly Cash Deposit Report
Auto Login POS report for last 7 days. No manual cookie.

parameters.jsCode: const pad=(n)=>String(n).padStart(2,'0'); const f=(d)=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; const now=new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Dubai'})); const end=new Date(now); const start=new Date(now); start.setDate(end.getDate()-6); return [{json:{from_date:f(start),to_date:f(end),period_label:`${f(start)} إلى ${f(end)}`}}];

parameters.content:
## Monthly Branch Report
Auto Login POS previous month report. No manual cookie.

parameters.jsCode: const pad=(n)=>String(n).padStart(2,'0'); const f=(d)=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; const now=new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Dubai'})); const firstThis=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),1); const lastPrev=new Date(firstThis); lastPrev.setDate(0); const firstPrev=new Date(lastPrev.getFullYear(),lastPrev.getMonth(),1); return [{json:{from_date:f(firstPrev),to_date:f(lastPrev),period_label:`${firstPrev.getFullYear()}-${pad(firstPrev.getMonth()+1)}`}}];

nodes.name: Fetch POS Monthly Report Auto Login

parameters.jsCode: const currentSummary=$json.summary||{}; const currentRange=$('Monthly Date Range').first().json; const pad=(n)=>String(n).padStart(2,'0'); const f=(d)=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; const parse=(value)=>{ const [y,m,d]=String(value||'').split('-').map(Number); return new Date(y,(m||1)-1,d||1); }; const firstCurrent=parse(currentRange.from_date); if(Number.isNaN(firstCurrent.getTime())) throw new Error('Invalid monthly from_date for comparison.'); const lastPrevious=new Date(firstCurrent); lastPrevious.setDate(0); const firstPrevious=new Date(lastPrevious.getFullYear(),lastPrevious.getMonth(),1); return [{json:{from_date:f(firstPrevious),to_date:f(lastPrevious),period_label:`${firstPrevious.getFullYear()}-${pad(firstPrevious.getMonth()+1)}`,current_summary:currentSummary,current_period_label:$json.period_label||currentRange.period_label,current_html_length:$json.html_length||0,current_used_username:$json.used_username||''}}];
